additional_info.subject: 170002059-KF11 problem
additional_info.body:
Hello Colleagues,
Yesterday we reconnected the power to this charging station at a different location after it was in storage.
Commissioning and initial power connection + version update was done about 5 months ago.
After we connected it to power and turned it on, a fault was discovered in the KF11 on the SCB side.
We ran tests in MobaXterm to check the IP addresses:
Then I tried swapping the network cables between KF11 and KF12 to see if there was a problem with one of the network cables.
Before and after the replacement:
As you can see there are no indicator lights on the KF11, we checked the branches and contacts.
Please support this problem, I would be happy to receive advice on spare parts other than the KF11.
This charging station is very far away, 5 hours drive, we plan to arrive on Sunday at noon.
Br,
Orel
